unweighted.convention: Fit_Par_A is the amplitude of the per-bin yield. Phi12 histograms sum adjacent 15 degree bins, so Delta phi_h is 30 degrees versus 15 degrees. Width-normalized A is Fit_Par_A/Delta phi_h. B and C are dimensionless and are not rescaled.
